criteria.description: Preserve source meaning, negation, qualifications, agency, chronology, certainty and factual scope.

anchors.0: Meaning reversed, unsupported claims added or material qualification lost.
anchors.1: Mostly faithful with a consequential nuance missing.
anchors.2: Meaning and all material qualifications are preserved.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Restore source meaning and qualifiers while keeping fluent target prose.

criteria.description: Produce idiomatic target prose with suitable locale, register and terminology.

anchors.0: Wrong target language or misleading cultural adaptation.
anchors.1: Understandable but source syntax, register or terminology remains awkward.
anchors.2: Fluent localization preserves register and approved terminology.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Improve target phrasing without changing source claims or intent.

criteria.description: Preserve protected markup, variables, links, code and specified exact tokens.

anchors.0: A required token is changed or absent.
anchors.1: Only part of the protected content is intact.
anchors.2: Every supplied protected token is retained exactly.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Restore exact protected elements in the translation.

criteria.description: Account for every supplied passage without adding unrelated explanation.

anchors.0: Material passage omitted or unrelated content replaces translation.
anchors.1: Minor omission or unnecessary explanation remains.
anchors.2: All source content is translated with appropriate correspondence.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Account for the missing passage and remove unrequested additions.

criteria.description: Respect supplied measurable UI length constraints without dropping meaning.

anchors.0: A supplied hard length limit is exceeded.
anchors.1: Some supplied measurable constraints remain unmet.
anchors.2: Every applicable UI length constraint is met.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Revise the UI string within its supplied limits while preserving meaning.
